body.zh:
## 这个版本有什么

- **新的面板外壳**：导航栏、列表和页面分层更清晰
- 公告现在是**资讯**：有图、有分类，可以在公告页里读全文
- 个性化移到了左下角

> 有问题可以问米塔 AI，也可以到 [文档](https://www.alkaidlab.com/docs/) 里查。

![面板外观](https://www.alkaidlab.com/announcement-banners/welcome-inline.webp)
body.en:
## What is in this version

- **A new panel shell**: the rail, the list and the page are layered more clearly
- Announcements are **news** now: with pictures and kinds, and the full text on the announcements page
- Personalisation moved to the bottom left

> Ask Mita AI if you get stuck, or read the [docs](https://www.alkaidlab.com/docs/).

![The panel](https://www.alkaidlab.com/announcement-banners/welcome-inline.webp)

body.zh:
### 新增

1. 资讯卡片（首页）
2. 公告支持 Markdown 和图片
3. 下次公告更新前不再显示

### 修复

- 虚拟显示器页面打开时不再闪动
- 配置文件页面首次进入不再空白
body.en:
### Added

1. A news tile on the home
2. Markdown and pictures in announcements
3. Do not show again until the announcement changes

### Fixed

- The virtual display page no longer flashes when it opens
- The configuration files page is no longer blank on the first visit

title.zh: 教程：给串流设置一块虚拟显示器
title.en: Guide: give a stream its own virtual display

body.zh:
虚拟显示器让串流有自己的分辨率和刷新率，不影响主显示器。

1. 打开 **显示 › 虚拟显示器**
2. 选择 *按需创建* 或 *始终存在*
3. 在客户端选择想要的分辨率

完整说明见 [文档](https://www.alkaidlab.com/docs/virtual-display)。
body.en:
A virtual display gives the stream its own resolution and refresh rate without touching the main monitor.

1. Open **Display › Virtual display**
2. Choose *on demand* or *always present*
3. Pick the resolution on the client

The full description is in the [docs](https://www.alkaidlab.com/docs/virtual-display).

body.zh: 旧版驱动在某些显卡上会导致串流花屏，请更新到最新版本。
body.en: Older drivers can cause corrupted video on some GPUs. Please update to the latest version.

body.zh:
## 使用须知

Foundation Sunshine 以 GPL-3.0 发布。

- 请只在你拥有或获得授权的电脑上使用
- 公网访问请设置强密码，并开启安全与登录
- 配对码只给自己的设备

第4条：请定期更新主机和客户端到同一版本

第5条：不要在不信任的网络上开放串流端口

第6条：遇到问题先查看日志与诊断页面

第7条：备份配置文件后再做大的改动

第8条：共享给他人的客户端请单独配对并可随时取消

第9条：公共场所串流时注意屏幕上的隐私信息

第10条：手柄与键鼠权限只授予可信设备

第11条：升级前请先结束正在进行的串流

第12条：完整条款见官网

**感谢使用。**
body.en:
## Terms of use

Foundation Sunshine is released under GPL-3.0.

- Use it only on computers you own or are allowed to use
- Set a strong password for public access and turn on sign-in
- Give pairing codes only to your own devices

Item 4: Keep the host and the clients on the same version

Item 5: Do not expose the streaming ports on networks you do not trust

Item 6: Check the logs and diagnostics page first when something breaks

Item 7: Back up the configuration before big changes

Item 8: Pair shared clients separately and revoke them when done

Item 9: Mind private information on screen when streaming in public

Item 10: Give gamepad and keyboard access to trusted devices only

Item 11: End a running stream before upgrading

Item 12: The full terms are on the website

**Thank you for using it.**

body.zh: 客户端找不到主机时，先确认两台设备在同一网络，再试 **二维码配对**。
body.en: If the client cannot find the host, check that both devices are on the same network, then try **QR pairing**.

body.zh: 手柄反馈、弱网表现和 macOS 客户端是接下来的重点。
body.en: Gamepad feedback, weak-network behaviour and the macOS client are next.
